name: marsh-boss-attacks
prompt: Create an expanded production animation sprite sheet of EXACTLY the same mossy root golem, amber eyes, heavy entangled wooden arms character in the reference, matching its painted cartoon dark fantasy style, colors, identity, proportions, clothing and outlines. Transparent background. Exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows = 24 separately isolated full-body poses with wide transparent gutters and no overlaps. Face RIGHT in a side three-quarter profile. Row 1, four successive phases of raising arms to summon swamp roots. Row 2, four phases of  chest opening to spit swamp lights. Row 3, four phases of  crouching then leaping and root-fist landing. Row 4, four phases of  sweeping both long root arms low. For each attack row: anticipation, stronger anticipation, clear dynamic strike, follow-through. Row 5, four dramatic awakening/power-up poses, arms/wings spreading, then settling. Row 6: two hit-recoil poses then two peaceful kneeling/resting defeat poses (kid friendly, no injury). Keep character consistent scale in ALL cells including crouching, same camera, entire weapons/wings inside own cell. Bottom aligned feet/reference anchor, no ground, no scenery, no text, no labels, no gridlines. Render only character and small attached magic, do NOT paint disconnected projectiles. Detailed matte hand-painted materials, crisp beautiful ink contours, readable at game size. Large landscape sheet with enough vertical space for SIX rows.
